title: Polygon vanaisheswhen applying Bone2D weights.
body:
### Tested versions

- reproducible in Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.steam (c) 2007-present 
- 


### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable (49a5bc7b6) - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated AMD  Radeon RX 7800 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.12033.1030) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

When attempting to apply bone weights to the polygon., the polygon stops rendering in the 2D view and no weights are applied to it. Polygon only reappears when removing the skeleton. 

### Steps to reproduce

To reproduce use the following steps.

- create scene
- create polygon2D node to scene root
- Reset the position of the polygon node to if its not at the world origin.
- add texture (used Icon.svg)
- create points for Polygon2D Node
- add skeleton2dNode to scene root
- add Bone2D Node to Skeleton2D node.
- Assign Skeleton2D to the Skeleton property of the Polygon2D Node.
- In the "Bone" Tab, press the Sync Bones to Polygon Button.
- Attempt to paint Weights. The Polygon should now vanish.
